svg.title: Error recovery only: retry a safer candidate or keep completed work
svg.desc: Ordinary candidate failures can use bounded search retreat or a safer tested final curve. Failed retries return to classification. Exhausted tiers are skipped; critical errors stop probing, while cancellation retains saved files without promising success.

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Record any instability
Exclude failed final pair
